Annex XII Chapter II 4 Certificate includes the manufacturer's SRN if already issued. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 5 Certificate states its date of issue. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 6 Certificate states its date of expiry. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 7 Certificate includes data identifying the device or devices unambiguously. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 8 Certificate references any previous certificate where applicable. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 9 Certificate cites the regulation and Annex used for the assessment. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 10 Certificate lists examinations and tests performed, with standards and reports referenced. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 11 Certificate references relevant technical documentation parts or other needed certificates. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 12 Certificate includes information on notified body surveillance where applicable. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 13 Certificate states the notified body's conclusions of the conformity assessment. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 14 Certificate lists conditions or limits on its validity. Coming soon
Annex XII Chapter II 15 Certificate bears the notified body's legally binding signature. Coming soon
Annex XIII PROCEDURE FOR CUSTOM-MADE DEVICES
Annex XIII 1 For custom-made devices, a statement with required information must be drawn up. Coming soon
Annex XIII 2 Manufacturer keeps documentation of sites, design, manufacture and performance available to national authorities. Coming soon
Annex XIII 3 Manufacturer ensures manufacturing follows the documented design for custom-made devices. Coming soon
Annex XIII 4 Custom-made device statement is kept at least 10 years, 15 for implantables. Coming soon
Annex XIII 5 Manufacturer reviews post-production experience, applies corrective action and reports serious incidents to authorities. Coming soon
Annex XIV CLINICAL EVALUATION AND POST-MARKET CLINICAL FOLLOW-UP
Annex XIV Part A CLINICAL EVALUATION
Annex XIV Part A 1 Manufacturers must plan, continuously conduct and document clinical evaluation.
Annex XIV Part A 1(a) Manufacturer sets up and updates a clinical evaluation plan with specified minimum elements. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part A 1(b) Manufacturer identifies clinical data and evidence gaps via systematic literature review. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part A 1(c) Manufacturer appraises relevant clinical data for suitability to establish safety and performance. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part A 1(d) Manufacturer generates new clinical data through well-designed investigations to resolve open issues. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part A 1(e) Manufacturer must analyse all relevant clinical data to conclude on safety, performance and benefits. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part A 2 Evaluation must be balanced, weighing positive and negative data, and scaled to device risk and claims. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part A 3 Data from an equivalent device may be used if technical, biological and clinical similarity is shown. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part A 4 Evaluation results and evidence go into a report within the technical documentation, including unfavourable data. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B POST-MARKET CLINICAL FOLLOW-UP
Annex XIV Part B 5 Post-market clinical follow-up is an ongoing process that actively gathers clinical data to confirm safety and performance. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6 Follow-up must be carried out following a documented plan.
Annex XIV Part B 6.1 The follow-up plan must set out methods for proactively collecting and evaluating clinical data.
Annex XIV Part B 6.1(a) Plan aims to confirm the device stays safe and performs well across its lifetime. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.1(b) Plan aims to find unknown side-effects and track known side-effects and contraindications. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.1(c) Plan aims to identify and analyse emerging risks using factual evidence. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.1(d) Plan aims to keep the benefit-risk balance acceptable. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.1(e) Plan aims to detect systematic misuse or off-label use and check the intended purpose. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2 Introduces the minimum contents of the follow-up plan.
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(a) Plan states general methods, such as user feedback and literature screening. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(b) Plan states specific methods, such as registers or dedicated follow-up studies. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(c) Plan justifies why the chosen methods are appropriate. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(d) Plan cross-references the clinical evaluation report and risk management documentation. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(e) Plan lists the specific objectives the follow-up must address. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(f) Plan includes assessment of clinical data from equivalent or similar devices. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(g) Plan refers to applicable common specifications, harmonised standards and guidance. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 6.2(h) Plan has a justified timetable for analysis and reporting activities. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 7 Manufacturer analyses follow-up findings and records them in an evaluation report within technical documentation. Coming soon
Annex XIV Part B 8 Follow-up conclusions feed clinical evaluation and risk management; needed preventive or corrective actions must be implemented. Coming soon
Annex XV CLINICAL INVESTIGATIONS
Annex XV Chapter I GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
Annex XV Chapter I 1 Ethical principlesEvery stage of a clinical investigation must follow recognised ethical principles. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2 MethodsHeading for methods requirements of clinical investigations.
Annex XV Chapter I 2.1 Investigations need a state-of-the-art plan with enough observations and a justified statistical design. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2.2 Investigation procedures must suit the device being studied. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2.3 Research methodologies must suit the device being studied. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2.4 Investigations follow the plan with enough users in realistic clinical settings, consistent with the evaluation plan. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2.5 Investigation design must cover safety and performance features and expected outcomes, with a feature list. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2.6 Endpoints must reflect purpose, benefits, performance and safety, using valid methods and a relevant primary endpoint. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2.7 Investigators get device data; staff are trained, with the sponsor verifying and documenting training. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter I 2.8 Investigator-signed report critically evaluates all collected data, including negative findings. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II DOCUMENTATION REGARDING THE APPLICATION FOR CLINICAL INVESTIGATIONSponsor submits an investigation application with the listed documents.
Annex XV Chapter II 1 Application formApplication form must be completed with the information listed below.
Annex XV Chapter II 1.1 Form gives sponsor contact details and any Union legal representative. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.2 Form gives manufacturer and authorised representative details when different from the sponsor. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.3 Form states the investigation's title. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.4 Form states whether this is a first submission, resubmission or significant amendment. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.5 Form details or references the clinical evaluation plan. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.6 For resubmissions, form cites earlier applications and explains changes made, including responses to reviews. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.7 If filed alongside a drug trial application, form gives its registration number. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.8 Form identifies the countries where the multi-site investigation will take place. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.9 Form briefly describes the investigational device and its classification. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.10 Form states whether the device contains medicinal substances or non-viable tissues or cells. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.11 Form summarises the plan: objectives, subjects, selection criteria, design and dates. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.12 Form identifies any comparator device and its classification. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.13 Sponsor shows investigator and site can conduct the study according to plan. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.14 Form gives expected start date and duration. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.15 Form identifies the notified body if already involved. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.16 Sponsor confirms awareness that the authority may contact the reviewing ethics committee. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 1.17 Form includes the manufacturer's conformity statement described in section 4.1. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2 Investigator's BrochureInvestigator's brochure must hold available clinical and non-clinical device information, kept updated for investigators.
Annex XV Chapter II 2.1 Brochure identifies and describes the device, purpose, classification, design and earlier generations. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2.2 Brochure includes manufacturer's installation, maintenance, use instructions, labelling information and training needs. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2.3 Brochure presents pre-clinical evaluation, including software verification and validation where applicable. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2.4 Brochure presents existing clinical data from literature and equivalent or similar devices. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2.5 Brochure summarises benefit-risk analysis, risk management, side-effects, contraindications and warnings. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2.6 For devices with medicinal or tissue constituents, brochure gives detailed information and evidence of added value. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2.7 Brochure lists fulfilment of Annex I requirements, standards applied and alternative solutions. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 2.8 Brochure describes clinical procedures and tests, noting departures from normal practice. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3 Clinical Investigation PlanInvestigation plan sets out rationale, objectives, methodology, monitoring, conduct, records and analysis.
Annex XV Chapter II 3.1 GeneralGeneral section heading of the investigation plan.
Annex XV Chapter II 3.1.1 Plan carries the investigation's single identification number. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.1.2 Plan identifies the sponsor and any Union representative. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.1.3 Plan names investigators, sites, emergency contacts, and defines investigator roles and qualifications. Coming soon

Annex XV Chapter II 3.1.5 Plan includes an overall synopsis in an official Union language. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.2 Plan describes the device, population, procedures, training, literature, state of the art and expected benefits. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.3 Plan covers risks and benefits with justification of expected outcomes. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.4 Plan explains the study's relevance to current clinical practice. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.5 Plan states objectives and hypotheses. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.6 Plan shows the design is scientifically robust and valid.
Annex XV Chapter II 3.6.1 Plan gives study type with rationale for it, endpoints and variables. Coming soon
Annex XV Chapter II 3.6.2 Plan describes the investigational device, comparators and other devices or medication used. Coming soon

Annex XV Chapter II 4 Other informationHeading for other information accompanying the application.
Annex XV Chapter II 4.1 Manufacturer signs a statement that the device meets requirements except the aspects under investigation. Coming soon

Reuse: Official EU legislation on EUR-Lex, free to read; reuse terms in the EUR-Lex legal notice (not re-checked); cite article numbers and paraphrase. Only identifiers, links and headings are shown, never the text; every summary and note is our own.

The sloptopop CLI and every language library are open source under MIT OR Apache-2.0, at github.com/sloptopop.

Transformations, A to Z: every step from the repository you start with to the branch you get back.

Slop to pop: design patterns: anti-patterns sloptopop converts into design patterns today, with the run that proves each one.

Results: what sloptopop did to every repository it was tested on.

Compliance, point by point and what each check evidences: what sloptopop checks and which controls each check evidences.

This site runs no JavaScript except htmx on the pricing page, to send the waitlist form; every animation is CSS. No cookies, no analytics, no third-party scripts.
